method: Descriptive aggregation of the frozen primary receipts; no new simulations or tuning. Same preregistered counters. Coach adaptation windows and hold details are bounded observer histories; maximum hold and strict pathological counts are full-run counters. Keeper no_recorded_contact does not establish whether a save was physically feasible. Twelve fixture units remain the inferential sample.
